title: Apple expands its American Manufacturing Program, adding Bosch, Cirrus Logic, TDK, and Qnity Electronics to make components in the US for products sold globally (MacKenzie Sigalos/CNBC)
summary: MacKenzie Sigalos / CNBC: Apple expands its American Manufacturing Program, adding Bosch, Cirrus Logic, TDK, and Qnity Electronics to make components in the US for products sold globally — Apple announced a significant expansion of its American Manufacturing Program on Thursday, bringing four new partners — Bosch …
